name: hazards
chapter: Core mechanics: trap damage (damaging collision primitives)
note: l4_traprooms (Xibalba's trap houses). Amounts are the primitives' own [O object data, tru.exe 0x48E040 / 0x4923C0]: a flame jet (ca_ei_flame_trap) 800, a crusher jaw's plate (ca_rb_crusher_slim) 12345. A hit starts the 30-frame invulnerability window (lara.drm +0x60). The teleport fixture only moves her between the houses; the walking, the jets' and jaws' clocks and the damage are the game's.

expect.note: touches within 30 frames of the hit are ignored
the plate on the closing jaw's face
the pair she stopped in opens for 2 s and slams shut at 65 units a frame
